crossRefs.note: Why does Yahweh bring us to this land, to fall by the sword? Our wives and our little ones will be captured or killed!…
But I will bring your little ones that you said should be captured or killed in, and they shall know the land which you…
He shall eat butter and honey when he knows to refuse the evil and choose the good.
For before the child knows to refuse the evil and choose the good, the land whose two kings you abhor shall be forsaken.
Shouldn’t I be concerned for Nineveh, that great city, in which are more than one hundred twenty thousand persons who…
For being not yet born, neither having done anything good or bad, that the purpose of God according to election might…
We also all once lived among them in the lusts of our flesh, doing the desires of the flesh and of the mind, and were…

translations.web: Moreover your little ones, whom you said would be captured or killed, your children, who today have no knowledge of good or evil, shall go in there. I will give it to them, and they shall possess it.
translations.bsb: And the little ones you said would become captives—your children who on that day did not know good from evil—will enter the land that I will give them, and they will possess it.
translations.kjv: Moreover your little ones, which ye said should be a prey, and your children, which in that day had no knowledge between good and evil, they shall go in thither, and unto them will I give it, and they shall possess
translations.asv: Moreover your little ones, that ye said should be a prey, and your children, that this day have no knowledge of good or evil, they shall go in thither, and unto them will I give it, and they shall possess it.
